name: file-operations
description: Everyday file and directory manipulation: creation, multi-line content, copying, permission bits, and a small directory tree. Medium difficulty — every task is provable on the local filesystem and several exercise multiple independent checks at once.

tasks.name: inbox-dir-and-marker
tasks.objective: create the directory /tmp/ada-bench-files/inbox and an empty marker file /tmp/ada-bench-files/inbox/.keep, and prove the directory exists and the marker file exists

tasks.name: three-line-notes
tasks.objective: write a file /tmp/ada-bench-files/notes.txt containing exactly the three lines 'alpha', 'beta', and 'gamma' (one per line), and prove the file contains all three lines

tasks.name: copy-with-content
tasks.objective: create /tmp/ada-bench-files/src.txt containing the line 'payload', copy it to /tmp/ada-bench-files/copy.txt, and prove that both files exist and both contain the line 'payload'

tasks.name: secret-mode-0600
tasks.objective: create /tmp/ada-bench-files/secret.conf containing the line 'token: abc123' with file mode 0600, and prove the file exists with that exact content and mode 0600

tasks.name: project-tree
tasks.objective: set up a project under /tmp/ada-bench-files/project with the subdirectories src, build, and dist, place a file project/src/main.txt containing the line 'entrypoint', and prove that all three subdirectories exist and that main.txt contains 'entrypoint'
